findings.description: The constructor stores direction and references without validation; confirm_high checks exact non-null callback and forwards the original point without inspecting its return.
findings.resolution: Clarify active source-derived contract; no production change.

findings.description: Choose first_direct from the gate-qualified records before checking stopped; if that selected direct record is unstopped, a later direct-only nonprimary record is not promoted by this method. Reset-leg eligibility is independent of direct selection. Audit causes preserve every deep-copied original cause, unlike the deduplicated cause-kind tuple. Number input is not used, and missing group keys or malformed required fields propagate rather than falling back.
findings.resolution: Clarify active source-derived contract; no production change.
